http/websocket_server#

Accepting WebSocket upgrades on a server.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

async handling(request is Request, context is HttpRequestContext) is HandlingResult {
    WebSocketHandlingResult(
        origin: WebSocketUpgrade(protocols: [], limits: WebSocketLimits(), access: SameOriginWebSockets(), deadline: Duration(seconds: 5.rat())),
        application: self,
    );
}

async handle(connection is WebSocketConnection, request is Request, context is HttpRequestContext) is WebSocketHandling {
    for await connection -> message { await connection.send(message); }
    self;
}

Description#

Accepting WebSocket upgrades on a server.

The server must be built with url: so that the Origin can be checked. The first protocol of the server's list that the client offers is chosen; no extensions are negotiated.

Public API#

object WebSocketUpgrade#

object WebSocketUpgrade

Explicit upgrade policy. Origin approval is mandatory; server preference orders subprotocol selection. No extension negotiation is implicit.

WebSocketUpgrade.WebSocketUpgrade#

WebSocketUpgrade(protocols is @string, limits is WebSocketLimits, access is WebSocketAllowing, deadline is Duration)

Accepts these protocols in order of preference, within limits, from origins access allows, finishing within deadline.

WebSocketUpgrade.protocols#

protocols() is @string

The protocols, preferred first.

limits() is WebSocketLimits

The message limits.

WebSocketUpgrade.access#

access() is WebSocketAllowing

WebSocketUpgrade.deadline#

object WebSocketAccepting#

object WebSocketAccepting

Dedicated server consumer adopts one HTTP1 head plus its exact over-read tail and the owned transport. The caller keeps the ordinary request handler scope separate from the eventual WebSocket application lifetime.

WebSocketAccepting.WebSocketAccepting#

WebSocketAccepting(input is AsyncReading, output is AsyncWriting, owner is Closing, head is Http1HeadRead<Http1RequestHead>, destination is UrlParts, upgrade is WebSocketUpgrade, clock is Timing)

Accepts the upgrade in head on input and output for destination, under upgrade.

WebSocketAccepting.connection#

async connection() is WebSocketConnection

Checks the Origin, answers 101 and gives the connection; WebSocketFailure when the Origin is denied.
